content.text: Current FHA mortgage ratesAs a lender, Zillow Home Loans is here to help you understand FHA rates to determine whether a FHA mortgage is the right loan option for you. Get pre-approved to see if you qualify for a FHA mortgage and get a personalized rate.What is an FHA loan?An FHA loan is a mortgage that’s insured by the Federal Housing Administration (FHA), a government agency that allows lenders like us to offer home loans with more lenient qualification requirements. It can be an attractive option for borrowers who need more flexible credit scores or a lower down payment. They are also popular with first-time homebuyers. Today’s FHA mortgage rate optionsHere are some of the 30-Year FHA mortgage rate options available from Zillow Home Loans.
